lore.common: Wheezes softly whenever it is picked up, as if it is clearing its throat.
lore.uncommon: Plays the same jolly tune whether the mood is happy, sad or a bit awkward.
lore.rare: Breathes in so hard between chords that it sucks every napkin off the next table.
lore.epic: Played so long at the street fair that it stretched to the length of a bus and had to be carried home in sections.
lore.legendary: Took one breath so deep at the harbour festival that it swallowed the sea breeze, and the sailing race had to wait for the song to end.

lore.common: Holds the music at just the right height, until somebody touches the wing nut.
lore.uncommon: Sinks slowly lower during every practice until the player is reading from their knees.
lore.rare: Turns the page by itself in a draught, always at the hardest bar of the piece.
lore.epic: Collapsed mid-recital and showered the front row in sheet music, and the audience clapped anyway.
lore.legendary: Stood firm through a gale at an outdoor concert. The orchestra blew away, but the music stayed open at page two.

lore.common: Is covered in tiny black notes that look like ants marching across a fence.
lore.uncommon: Has a coffee ring right over the trickiest bar, so nobody can read it.
lore.rare: Rearranges its own notes while nobody is looking, so every piece ends as a different song.
lore.epic: Blew out of the window during practice, and the neighbours hummed the tune all week.
lore.legendary: Its notes marched off the page one night and formed a choir on the windowsill. They only know scales.

lore.common: Plays a tiny tinkling tune while a little dancer turns on top.
lore.uncommon: Plays its tune perfectly until somebody listens closely, then hits one wrong note on purpose.
lore.rare: Plays its tune so sweetly that anyone listening forgets what they were angry about.
lore.epic: Was wound a thousand turns too many and played without stopping through a whole wedding, speeches included.
lore.legendary: Its tiny dancer spun so fast that she took off, flew twice round the room and landed back on top with a curtsy.

lore.common: Ticks back and forth at a steady pace, judging every note it hears.
lore.uncommon: Stops ticking the moment the teacher leaves the room and starts again when she comes back.
lore.rare: Ticks so loudly that the player plays in time even when they don't want to.
lore.epic: Kept a whole school orchestra so perfectly in time that the conductor sat down and let it lead.
lore.legendary: Kept such strict time that the school choir hiccupped in perfect rhythm, and they performed it as an encore.

lore.common: Ticks in time with music and also happens to tell the time.
lore.uncommon: Chimes at the top of every hour, right in the middle of a quiet piece.
lore.rare: Ticks so loudly that every clock in the room starts ticking at the same speed.
lore.epic: Kept time for the whole marching band one Saturday, and nobody went the wrong way round the park.
lore.legendary: Chimed noon in the middle of a concert so exactly on the beat that the orchestra made it the final note, and now it takes a bow every hour.

names.legendary: Bop and Bop, the Tide Twins

lore.common: Sits between the knees and goes bop-bop whenever hands come near.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone in the room tap their fingers on the table without thinking.
lore.rare: Plays a rhythm so catchy that the cat starts walking in time.
lore.epic: Played so fast at a beach party that the sand started bouncing, and every sandcastle shuffled into the sea.
lore.legendary: Played a rhythm so catchy that the waves started breaking on the beat, and the surfers now need a drummer to count them in.

lore.common: Looks like a plain wooden box until somebody sits on it and starts slapping.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a stool by everyone who doesn't know it is a drum.
lore.rare: Thumps so deeply that the floorboards shake along with every beat.
lore.epic: Played the whole drum part at a campfire singalong, and the sausages bounced in the pan.
lore.legendary: Was sat on by a whole school choir at once, and the thump it gave back showed up on the town earthquake meter.

lore.common: Stands tall on the floor and makes a deep warm thump when hit.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone nearby want to form a line and wiggle across the room.
lore.rare: Pounds so loudly that every glass on the table hops in time.
lore.epic: Thumped so deeply at a carnival that the manhole covers hopped in time and a sewer worker climbed out to join the band.
lore.legendary: Led a parade so long that the front was home for tea before the back had started.

lore.common: Is shaped like a big goblet and makes a sharp slap when hit at the edge.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who sees it want to have a go, even the shy ones.
lore.rare: Slaps back. Anyone who hits it out of time gets a sharp little sting in the palm.
lore.epic: Drummed so hard at a garden party that every apple fell off the trees at once, and the party became a crumble.
lore.legendary: Played a rhythm so strong that the whole town took it as its heartbeat, and every doctor now hears ba-dum-tak through the stethoscope.

lore.common: Booms deeply when hit and makes the floorboards vibrate.
lore.uncommon: Gets hit at seven o'clock every Saturday morning by somebody who just got it for their birthday.
lore.rare: Booms so loudly that every dog in the street starts howling along.
lore.epic: Was hit so hard in a garage solo that the sticks flew out of the window, and the neighbour returned them with a bag of earplugs.
lore.legendary: Played such a mighty solo at a festival that the clouds parted to listen.

lore.common: Sits at the back of the orchestra like a giant copper bowl waiting for its moment.
lore.uncommon: Rumbles so low that it is felt in the stomach before it is heard.
lore.rare: Booms so low that every jelly within a mile wobbles, and the school canteen has given up on pudding.
lore.epic: Played the finale so hard that the conductor's hair stood straight up.
lore.legendary: Played a finale so huge that the concert hall roof lifted off, took a bow and settled back one seat to the left.

lore.common: Goes tap-tap-tap with two tiny sticks and a lot of enthusiasm.
lore.uncommon: Gets played most loudly at the exact moment the baby falls asleep.
lore.rare: Turns any small child into a marching band of one, round and round the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was played on a long car journey, and the whole family learned to sing very loudly.
lore.legendary: Was banged so hard at a birthday that the candles blew themselves out, and the toddler got the wish.

lore.common: Stands taller than its player and hums so low that it sounds like a sleepy bear.
lore.uncommon: Needs its own seat on the bus, which makes everyone stare.
lore.rare: Plays such a low note that the fruit bowl starts to shake.
lore.epic: Played a note so low at a jazz club that the ice cracked in every glass and the goldfish in the lobby swam in circles.
lore.legendary: Played such a low note that a whale three seas away answered, and now they are pen pals.

lore.common: Has four thick strings and a habit of making everything sound groovier.
lore.uncommon: Rattles the windows of the garage whenever the amplifier is turned up.
lore.rare: Plays so low that the speakers walk across the stage by themselves.
lore.epic: Thumped so hard in a garage rehearsal that every paint tin on the shelf popped its lid, and the walls came out purple.
lore.legendary: Played a bassline so mighty that the whole venue moved one foot to the left.

lore.common: Sits in the corner with one string slightly out of tune, waiting to be strummed.
lore.uncommon: Snaps a string just before the best bit of every song.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who holds it start strumming the same three chords for an hour.
lore.epic: Played one power chord in a bedroom so loudly that every sock in the drawer stood up.
lore.legendary: Played a chord so perfect that every guitar in town tuned itself to match, including one that was still a tree.

lore.common: Has a round belly and a bent neck, like it has eaten too much at a feast.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long to tune that the song is over before it is ready.
lore.rare: Plays such old songs that anyone listening speaks in thee and thou for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Played at a medieval fair so beautifully that the knights forgot to joust.
lore.legendary: Played a ballad so old-fashioned that a ruined castle rebuilt itself to listen, then asked it to stay as the house band.

lore.common: Has eight little strings that shimmer when played fast.
lore.uncommon: Sounds like a whole flock of birds when someone strums it too quickly.
lore.rare: Plays such a fast tremble that the audience's teeth start to rattle.
lore.epic: Played a serenade so sweetly on the harbour that the fishing boats came back early.
lore.legendary: Serenaded a lighthouse so sweetly that it now winks at every boat that passes.

lore.common: Has a long neck and a round gourd body that hums with sympathetic strings.
lore.uncommon: Has a neck so long that it knocks the lampshade every time it is picked up.
lore.rare: Bends its notes so far that the curtains, the cat and the spaghetti all bend along.
lore.epic: Played an evening so hypnotic that the whole audience missed the last bus home.
lore.legendary: Played one raga so slowly that a snail crossed the garden and back before the second note.

lore.common: Has so many strings that nobody but its player knows which is which.
lore.uncommon: Needs re-tuning every time the room gets slightly warmer.
lore.rare: Ripples out notes so gently that the whole room drifts into a daydream.
lore.epic: Played so softly at a wedding that the guests fell asleep, and the bride had to throw the bouquet at a snoring uncle.
lore.legendary: Played a tune by the river so beautiful that the river turned round and flowed backwards for an encore.

lore.common: Gets tapped twice and asked if it is working, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Squeals when anyone walks in front of the speakers.
lore.rare: Makes even the shyest person sing far too loudly once they hold it.
lore.epic: Was grabbed at a karaoke night and not put down until four in the morning.
lore.legendary: Picked up a whisper so well that a whole stadium heard the secret, and now everyone knows who ate the last biscuit.

lore.common: Has eighty-eight keys and a lid that bangs shut unexpectedly.
lore.uncommon: Has one key in the middle that sticks, and it is always in the easy song.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who passes play the same two-note tune with one finger.
lore.epic: Hosted a living room concert so good that the neighbours bought tickets for the next one.
lore.legendary: Fell out of the movers van on a hill, rolled all the way down playing a scale, and stopped at the right house.

lore.common: Makes eerie wobbling sounds when hands wave near it without touching.
lore.uncommon: Wails whenever the cat walks past, which frightens the cat every time.
lore.rare: Plays a spooky tune whenever anyone yawns near it, so every bedtime comes with music.
lore.epic: Gave a school play the spookiest soundtrack ever, and the ghost costume was hardly needed.
lore.legendary: Was played by an octopus at the aquarium, and the eight-armed concert was so spooky that the sharks hid.

lore.common: Has twelve tiny keys that make a sweet plinking sound.
lore.uncommon: Has one key that plays a note completely different from the others.
lore.rare: Turns any toddler into a concert pianist for exactly five minutes.
lore.epic: Played a nursery recital so loudly that the parents clapped in self-defence.
lore.legendary: Played its twelve keys so fiercely at a concert that the grand piano resigned and became a coffee table.

lore.common: Has bright rainbow bars that make a different sound with every tap.
lore.uncommon: Hides one mallet in the toy box and the other in the dog's bed, every single day.
lore.rare: Swaps its bars round every night, so every song comes out as a different nursery rhyme.
lore.epic: Was played so hard at playgroup that a bar flew off, bounced off the goldfish bowl and landed in the teacher's tea.
lore.legendary: Was played so happily by a toddler that the rainbow outside rearranged its colours to match the bars.

lore.common: Groans like a startled goose when first filled up.
lore.uncommon: Takes a whole minute of wheezing before it plays a proper note.
lore.rare: Keeps wailing for a full minute after the piper stops, like a goose that refuses to be shushed.
lore.epic: Played a whole highland morning so loudly that the sheep lined up in neat rows.
lore.legendary: Was squeezed so hard at the highland games that it puffed up like a balloon and floated the piper across the loch, still playing.

lore.common: Only plays a few notes but plays them very loudly.
lore.uncommon: Blows a wake-up call every morning, even on holidays.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who hears it stand up straight and salute without knowing why.
lore.epic: Woke a whole campsite of scouts at dawn, and they all fell out of their tents.
lore.legendary: Played the dinner call so convincingly that a whole herd of cows came in from the field and sat down at the tables.

lore.common: Hums a long low drone that sounds like a giant, very relaxed bee.
lore.uncommon: Makes its player's lips tickle for an hour after every practice.
lore.rare: Drones so deeply that the floorboards hum along and the cutlery trembles.
lore.epic: Droned so deeply in the garden that every worm came up to see what was happening, and the blackbirds threw a party.
lore.legendary: Droned so deep that the bath upstairs turned into a whirlpool, and the rubber duck went round for a week.

lore.common: Is shiny and round and makes a warm, mellow sound like a friendly bear.
lore.uncommon: Lets out a little burp of a note whenever it is put down too quickly.
lore.rare: Plays so warmly that ice creams melt in the front row, and the bandstand has a puddle by the second tune.
lore.epic: Played the bandstand on a Sunday so happily that the ducks paddled in rhythm.
lore.legendary: Played so mellow a tune that a grumpy bull in the next field lay down, rolled over and asked for a tummy rub.

lore.common: Sits in a back pocket and comes out whenever there is a long wait.
lore.uncommon: Plays the wrong note on the in-breath every single time.
lore.rare: Plays such sad blues that the milk in the fridge goes sour out of sympathy.
lore.epic: Played the blues on a station platform so well that the train waited for the last note.
lore.legendary: Played a blues so lonely that a passing train stopped, reversed and gave it a lift home.

lore.common: Is so small that it lives on a keyring and plays four notes.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in the bottom of a bag among the receipts and crumbs.
lore.rare: Is so small that it gets sneezed out of a pocket by accident, playing a chord on the way.
lore.epic: Fell down a drain and played a tune every time the wind blew, so the whole street danced round the drain for a week.
lore.legendary: Played a chord so huge from inside a pocket that the trousers did a little dance on their own.

lore.common: Buzzes like a bee when somebody hums into it.
lore.uncommon: Makes every song sound slightly ridiculous, no matter how serious it is.
lore.rare: Turns any speech into a buzz, so the head teacher's announcements sound like a very cross bee.
lore.epic: Led a whole birthday party in a buzzing band that made the grown-ups cry with laughter.
lore.legendary: Buzzed so convincingly that a whole hive of bees moved in and now hums the harmony.

lore.common: Is a little keyboard played by blowing into a tube, which confuses everybody.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a tiny puddle on its tube after every music lesson.
lore.rare: Blows back. Anyone who puffs too hard gets a little squeak of air right up the nose.
lore.epic: Played every part in the school band when the others forgot their instruments.
lore.legendary: Played the piano part and the trumpet part at once so well that the real piano and trumpet left together in a huff.

lore.common: Is the smallest flute in the band and somehow the loudest.
lore.uncommon: Hits a note so high that the dog leaves the room.
lore.rare: Plays such piercing notes that the glasses on the table ring along.
lore.epic: Played over the top of a whole marching band, and the crowd heard nothing else.
lore.legendary: Hit a note so high that every bat in town flew in to complain, and now it gives them singing lessons.

lore.common: Squeaks a little on the first note and on most of the others.
lore.uncommon: Comes home from school every day and is practised loudly in the kitchen.
lore.rare: Plays the same nursery tune so often that the whole family hums it in their sleep.
lore.epic: Squeaked through a whole school assembly, and the head teacher clapped with her eyes shut.
lore.legendary: Played one song perfectly in tune, and the music teacher was so shocked that she has been on holiday ever since.

lore.common: Wraps round its player like a shiny brass snake with an enormous mouth.
lore.uncommon: Catches the wind in its giant bell and spins its player round in the breeze.
lore.rare: Has a bell so big that it catches rain, leaves and once a small football, and toots them all back out.
lore.epic: Led a whole parade with an oompah so loud that the floats bounced along.
lore.legendary: Oompahed so deeply that a family of pigeons moved into its bell and now come out to bow at the end of every march.

lore.common: Is shiny and brassy and very proud of its loud, clear sound.
lore.uncommon: Plays a sour note whenever its player is trying to impress someone.
lore.rare: Blasts a fanfare so loud that everyone in the room stands up.
lore.epic: Played a fanfare at the school fete so loud that the tombola spun on its own.
lore.legendary: Blew a fanfare so grand that every pigeon in the square landed in rows and saluted.

lore.common: Sits under the chin and squeaks a little whenever the bow slips.
lore.uncommon: Makes cats run for the garden whenever practice begins.
lore.rare: Plays a high note so sharp that it pops every soap bubble in the room.
lore.epic: Squeaked through a grade exam so bravely that the examiner gave it a round of applause.
lore.legendary: Played a tune so sad that the onions in the kitchen stopped making people cry, out of respect.

lore.common: Hangs together in a happy yellow cluster on the fruit bowl.
lore.uncommon: Turns spotty brown all at the same time, the day after it is bought.
lore.rare: Makes every lunchbox it touches taste of banana, the cheese sandwiches included.
lore.epic: Was left in a hot car and came out as banana bread on the back seat.
lore.legendary: Grows one extra banana every time it is counted, and the fruit bowl is now a fruit wardrobe.

lore.common: Lies yellow side down on the floor, waiting for someone in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Gets left on the bus seat by somebody who never finished their snack.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who steps on it do a little dance before they land.
lore.epic: Sent a whole football team sliding off the pitch like a row of skittles.
lore.legendary: Sent a whole marathon sliding past the finish line, and the slowest runner won by standing still.

lore.common: Has a banana, three scoops of ice cream and a cherry that nobody wants to share.
lore.uncommon: Melts just as everyone is still deciding who gets the cherry.
lore.rare: Splits in two whenever two people reach for it, and each half insists it is the bigger one.
lore.epic: Was built so long at an ice-cream parlour that it reached the door, and customers had to step over the cherry.
lore.legendary: Was so cold that the whole beach got brain freeze at once, and the heatwave was called off.

lore.common: Rings a clear ding whenever it is shaken, even when nobody meant to.
lore.uncommon: Rings loudly whenever anybody walks past it with heavy feet.
lore.rare: Rings by itself whenever someone tells a fib, which has made birthdays very awkward.
lore.epic: Was rung for dinner so loudly that the neighbours came too.
lore.legendary: Rang at a fib told on the far side of town, so loudly that the fibber owned up before the echo stopped.

lore.common: Clacks together in the palm with a sound like chattering teeth.
lore.uncommon: Clicks at completely the wrong moment in every song.
lore.rare: Clacks so fast that nearby teeth start chattering along, even on a hot day.
lore.epic: Clacked through a whole school dance show, and the stage floor shook with stamping.
lore.legendary: Clicked a rhythm so fast at a fiesta that the musicians had to run to keep up.

lore.common: Hangs high in a stone tower and rings out every hour across the rooftops.
lore.uncommon: Rings so early on a Saturday that the whole village wakes up and blames the cockerel.
lore.rare: Rings so loudly that pigeons fly off every roof in town at once.
lore.epic: Swung so hard on fete day that the tower swayed and the weathervane turned to face the cake stall.
lore.legendary: Rang so far on a still evening that it was heard in seven villages and a lighthouse.

lore.common: Clonks gently as its cow wanders through the meadow.
lore.uncommon: Rings the moment the cow tries to sneak into the vegetable patch.
lore.rare: Clangs so loudly that the cow cannot hear the farmer, and pretends it never could.
lore.epic: Clanged through a whole mountain festival, and every cow in the valley joined the parade.
lore.legendary: Clanged so bossily that the whole herd made it head cow, and it now gets the first patch of clover.

lore.common: Waits patiently for the one moment in the song when it gets to crash.
lore.uncommon: Crashes a beat too early every single time.
lore.rare: Shimmers so long after one crash that the next song has to start in its key.
lore.epic: Crashed so loudly in the school concert that the head teacher woke up.
lore.legendary: Crashed so hard that it split a raincloud in two, and the concert had sunshine on one side and drizzle on the other.

lore.common: Is a tiny triangle of plastic that makes every strum sound sharper.
lore.uncommon: Vanishes into the sofa cushions the moment the song starts.
lore.rare: Hides so well that every guitarist in the house must strum with a coin instead.
lore.epic: Was lost and found seven times in one gig, once in the singer's hair.
lore.legendary: Hid so well that it was found inside a sealed guitar, a locked safe and a boiled egg.

lore.common: Rings a clear note when shaken, and is passed round the classroom for turns.
lore.uncommon: Rings by accident whenever anyone picks it up from the shelf.
lore.rare: Rings whenever anyone in the class is daydreaming, which makes Friday afternoons very noisy.
lore.epic: Rang in a choir of handbells so beautifully that the audience joined in humming.
lore.legendary: Rang the end of break so firmly that the whole playground froze mid-game, football included, until it was put away.

lore.common: Snaps its two cymbals together with a crisp chick-chick sound.
lore.uncommon: Sizzles so long after being hit that the drummer has to stop it with a hand.
lore.rare: Snaps shut on anything left between its cymbals, including a drummer's sandwich and once a tie.
lore.epic: Kept a jazz band in time all night, and the dancers never missed a step.
lore.legendary: Played itself so well that the drummer went on holiday, and nobody noticed for three tours.

lore.common: Crunches loudly enough to be heard across the playground.
lore.uncommon: Snaps in half the moment it touches the dip, every single time.
lore.rare: Breaks into so many salty crumbs that the sofa, the bed and the dog are all seasoned by bedtime.
lore.epic: Was shared at a picnic so many times that every guest got exactly one crisp.
lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly in a library that every book fell off the shelves, in alphabetical order.

lore.common: Patters like rain when tipped, and is never quite finished pattering.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who hears it think they left the window open.
lore.rare: Patters so softly that anyone listening falls asleep in under a minute, including whoever is holding it.
lore.epic: Got wedged in a car roof rack, and the car drove through town sounding like its own private storm.
lore.legendary: Was tipped so gently in a dry summer that the next day it really did rain.

lore.common: Rattles whenever it is moved, so it is impossible to hide in a toy box.
lore.uncommon: Rolls under the sofa and keeps rattling every time someone walks past.
lore.rare: Shakes itself whenever it hears music, so every advert on the telly comes with percussion.
lore.epic: Started a samba in the kitchen that went out the door and down the street.
lore.legendary: Was shaken so hard that its beads burst out, bounced down the street and formed their own tiny band.

lore.common: Hums when its rim is rubbed with a wooden stick, like a very calm bee.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a fruit bowl by visitors, then hums loudly the moment anyone takes an apple.
lore.rare: Hums so soothingly that everyone in the room breathes more slowly.
lore.epic: Calmed a noisy classroom so completely that the teacher fell asleep at her desk.
lore.legendary: Hummed so calmly that the traffic outside slowed to walking pace, and nobody minded being late.

lore.common: Waits quietly through the whole piece for its single ting.
lore.uncommon: Gets dropped on the floor and tings much louder than it was supposed to.
lore.rare: Tings so brightly that every spoon in the drawer rings back, always on the wrong beat.
lore.epic: Got one ting in the school concert and was cheered louder than the trumpets.
lore.legendary: Went ting once so perfectly that the conductor put down the baton, and the triangle has been conducting ever since.

lore.common: Tinkles softly on the porch whenever the wind passes by.
lore.uncommon: Jangles all night during windy weather, keeping half the street awake.
lore.rare: Jangles at the faintest breath, so even a sneeze in the next garden sets it off.
lore.epic: Jangled so loudly in a storm that the neighbours thought it was a fire alarm.
lore.legendary: Caught a breeze so mighty that it played the whole storm like a song, and the weather forecast now comes with sheet music.

lore.common: Has rows of wooden bars that bounce mallets back up with a hollow tock.
lore.uncommon: Gets bars knocked out of place whenever someone plays too hard.
lore.rare: Ripples out notes so fast that the audience can't see the mallets.
lore.epic: Played so fast at a concert that the mallets got warm and the bars glowed.
lore.legendary: Played a scale so fast that the notes arrived before the mallets hit them, and the audience clapped before it began.
